name: Caddy WAF
comment: Caddy built with the caddy-waf module (github.com/fabriziosalmi/caddy-waf). Follows Caddy's releases and caddy-waf's releases: a new caddy-waf release on the same Caddy is published as a rebuild with a fourth version number (2.11.8 -> 2.11.8.1). Before an update the new build must accept the server's Caddyfile, and every site must answer as before afterwards (else it is rolled back). Takes over /usr/bin/caddy and caddy.service from the plain Caddy build while installed.
